messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — across the last three postmortems were seeing a repeating authz pattern: token validation failures after rolling deploys, plus missing audit records for service-account rotations. Need clear owners, timelines, and short-term mitigations so this stops recurring.

Alex Kim: I can help. Can someone paste a representative error / log we should use for the post-deploy smoke test?

Maya Chen: Example we've been seeing:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: exp check failed, iss mismatch, request_id=abcd-1234
```

Jordan Patel: Also observed: a short burst of `cache-miss` events from envoy within ~30s of deploys. Hypothesis: stale JWKs or delayed key-cache invalidation.

Sasha R.: Audit side shows gaps: `service-account:rotate` events missing in two incidents. Rotations completed but no durable audit write. We need a write+confirm pattern before rotation commit.

Leo Ortiz: Minimal remediation proposal:
1) Post-deploy token smokecheck (signed token validated end-to-end).
2) Rotation flow: synchronous audit write + retry/confirm before finalizing rotation.
3) Orphaned-creds sweep automation and runbook.
4) Authz trend dashboard & weekly anomaly alert.
Volunteer owners and target dates?

Maya Chen: Proposed owners / due dates:
- Alex Kim — deploy-time token smoke script + CI gating (due 2026-04-01)
- Sasha R. — audit-write guarantee + retries + tests (due 2026-04-08)
- Jordan Patel — runbook + orphaned-creds sweep automation (due 2026-04-15)
- Leo Ortiz — authz trend dashboard + alerts (due 2026-03-29)
I'll put these into the remediation tracker once owners ack.

Alex Kim: ack. Will add a small smoke script to infra/ci (curl + token validation). Opening PR and will link the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/758

Sasha R.: ack. Ill add a synchronous write+confirm step to the rotation flow and include retry loop and unit/integration tests. ETA 1 week.

Jordan Patel: Ill draft the runbook section "Detecting and remediating orphaned creds" and propose a k8s cron job to sweep stale tokens. RFC by Friday.

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5691 assigned to Alex Kim, due 2026-04-01

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5692 assigned to Sasha R., due 2026-04-08

Maya Chen: Suggest a recurring 30-min monthly "authz retro" to review trends and unblock owners. Who can attend?

Leo Ortiz: Ill host the dashboard and the first retro.

Alex Kim: Ill attend.

Jordan Patel: In.

Sasha R.: In.

Maya Chen: Great — Ill schedule the recurring meeting and post the playbook link here: https://redwood.internal/docs/authz-triage-playbook

Maya Chen: Operational note: if you cant meet your owner deadline, flag here 48h before so we can reassign or reduce scope. Thanks everyone :pray:
